name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days when he joined the Formula Student team, leading the aerodynamics division. He transitioned to karting after graduation, analyzing race data and developing winning strategies for local teams. His understanding of vehicle dynamics and race tactics quickly earned him a reputation as a rising strategist.

At Kosmic Kart, Ahmad focuses on optimizing kart setup and race strategy through detailed simulations and data analysis. He emphasizes understanding the nuances of each track and adapting the strategy accordingly. His 'big picture' thinking allows him to anticipate competitor moves and identify opportunities for his team. Ahmad believes in a data-driven approach, but he also values the intuition of the drivers and mechanics, fostering a collaborative environment.

What sets Ahmad apart is his ability to quickly process large amounts of information under pressure and make crucial decisions in real-time. His calm demeanor and clear communication style ensure that his strategies are effectively implemented, making him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of teh tarik (milk tea) before every race.
